notes.title: New Update on the horizon
notes.content:
Greeting,

It was a very exciting week for us as we pushed the release button on our first Early Access game.

Our focus has been on getting our hands on some fixes and improvements to Forgotten Skies and we will have a new update on the horizon in a short while.

What has been done?


We mainly focused on fixing some issues with traveling to a new map region, and we also improved the loading screens with some minor tweaks.
Meanwhile, we've added a new discoverable NPC that will allow you to delve deeper into the game's storyline; now you'll be able to get the first clues as to where you are and what else is happening around you in this bizarre world of Forgotten Skies.

We have also fixed an incorrect transition when reaching a certain point on the map, which caused you to go back to where the game started. This has now been fixed with the new update and will now take you to the correct point in your adventure journey.

Anything else?

Of course, we are happy to announce that we are bringing back controller support with the new update. You may now have all the keybindings available to use with your favorite controller.

We hope you will enjoy this update and if you have any further suggestions or feedback, we would love to hear it from you to continue improving the gaming experience.
You can join us either on the Steam Community of Forgotten Skies or on our official Discord Server.

We have also changed the video section of the game's store page and added a new gameplay video to the store, here's the new gameplay video:

[previewyoutube=oRBolP2IYSs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Road to Early Access: Join our Competition and win a Free Game Key
notes.content:
Greetings to all prospective adventurers!

We're just weeks away. Our hilarious platform adventure Forgotten Skies will be released into Early Access and the funny adventure will begin.
To celebrate, we have launched a weekly contest on our social media channels, which will take place every Saturday on X, Instagram and Threads.

With a little luck, you could win a free game code for Forgotten Skies, which will be sent to you on launch day to redeem on Steam.

Follow us on social media to find out how you can get involved when each new round starts on Saturday. You can find us on each of the following social media networks:


X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Threads

notes.title: Roadmap of Forgotten Skies
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/54346311fa8bc54a5ee400ca62be69fa08a7affa.png

Greetings Adventurers,

After we have been working hard over the last few weeks on further improvements (both for the demo as well as for the upcoming Early Access version), we would like to give you an insight into the further processes and procedures around the upcoming Early Access launch of Forgotten Skies.
For this purpose, we have published a roadmap. It gives you a rough overview of the upcoming content of the game.

In the third quarter (after the launch of Early Access), our main focus will be on technical aspects and improvements that will fundamentally improve the game experience for a wide range of players and their system configurations. This will result in the smoothest and most fluid gameplay possible.
Immediately after the launch of Early Access, we will integrate Intel's XeSS technology, AMD's FidelityFX technology and Nvidia's DLSS technology into the game.
This way, depending on which system you have, you can choose the best option for you and decide which technology you want to use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/285f802474554aa5f21f60533ae27bfe0ab628ea.png

In addition to the first QoL (Quality of Life) update, the first map expansion will be added to the game later this year, featuring a larger map and a variety of new adventures and discoveries.

When it comes to next year, our focus will be shifting to expanding and improving the Story- and Questline within the Game but also delivering a complete new gameplay experience with integrating a Mining System into Forgotten Skies which will be available through various Quests and Explorations.
In Addition, there will be also a 2nd Map Expansion with new Content and Adventures and our 2nd QoL Update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/88741ce163bd9d045b824ebab78faa310c6b5c18.png

So it is with these words that we look forward to seeing you up in the skies very soon, and hope that you'll have a fun and adventurous time in Forgotten Skies!


ROADMAP DETAILS


2024

Third Quarter

 DLSS, FSR and XeSS performance improvements
 Improvements to the UI & UX


Fourth Quarter

 First Map Expansion
 First QoL update (combat improvements, companion system, dialog improvements)



2025

Second Quarter

 Quest and Story Enhancements

-- End of Early Access --

Third Quarter

 Second Map Expansion


Fourth Quarter

 Mining System
 Second QoL Update

notes.title: 🎮 Join the Adventure: Forgotten Skies Beta Playtest on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/16eb6e3985be688c3078c005ef857d0e4f2eaef7.jpg

We're thrilled to invite you to be a part of our Beta Playtest on Steam, where you can experience hilarious and antertaining gameplay of our upcoming third-person Platformer-Adventure before anyone else!

Discover the mysteries of Forgotten Skies, a fun platforming adventure where ancient secrets and hidden dangers await in this captivating adventure game. Forgotten Skies invites you on an incredible journey into a world of mystery and adventure and fascinating unique creatures.
We're thrilled to invite you to be a part of our Beta Playtest on Steam, where you can experience hilarious and antertaining gameplay of our upcoming third-person Platformer-Adventure before anyone else!


What is Forgotten Skies?

Forgotten Skies is a captivating action-adventure game set in a sprawling universe teeming with secrets and surprises. As a daring explorer, you'll navigate through breathtaking landscapes, encounter enigmatic creatures, and uncover ancient civilizations lost to time.

Why Join the Beta Playtest?


 Be Among the First: Get an exclusive sneak peek at the game before its official release.
 Shape the Experience: Your feedback will help us fine-tune gameplay mechanics, squash bugs, and create an unforgettable adventure.
 Connect with Developers: Engage directly with the development team, share your thoughts, and help shape the future of Forgotten Skies.


How to Participate:

[olist]
 Sign Up: Simply visit our Steam page and opt into the Beta Playtest.
 Download the Game: Once accepted, download the Beta version of Forgotten Skies to your Steam library.
 Play & Provide Feedback: Dive into the world of Forgotten Skies, explore to your heart's content, and share your thoughts, suggestions, and any issues you encounter with us on the official Forum on Steam of Forgotten Skies Playtest
[/olist]

Important Details:


 Beta Start Date: April, 26 2024
 Beta End Date: June, 30 2024
 Platform: Steam (PC)
 Minimum System Requirements: Windows 10 / Windows 11 x64, Intel® Core™ Prozessor i3-2100 | AMD FX-6300, 8 GB RAM, Nvidia GeForce GTX 760 | AMD Radeon 7950


Spread the Word!

Invite your friends, fellow gamers, and anyone who loves adventure to join the Forgotten Skies Beta Playtest. The more feedback we receive, the better we can make the game for everyone!
